Introduction
This document outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must 
be performed every six years or every 500 operation as indicated by Y6 in 
 the above title block.
The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Amgad Abd El-Aziz, reviewed 
 by eng Wageh Khalil, 
 accepted by eng Ali Zahran general manager, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control 
 eng. Adel El Naggar, approved by eng Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria 
 Power Station,
This document certified by eng 
 . Samir abd El-Gelil general manager and MPIS coordinator and 
 approved by eng. Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay inspection and quality head 
 sector.

Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety 
shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses.
Circuit breaker must be fully isolated.
Earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker.
